title: Missions project config
description: Schema for .luuna/missions/config.yaml. Consumed by schema-driven configuration UIs; emit via `luuna-missions config schema`.

project.title: Project name
project.description: Used as the prefix for issue IDs (e.g. `<project>-a1b2`).

version.title: Config schema version
version.description: Internal version tag for the config layout. Bumped when the schema breaks.

max_plan_depth.title: Max plan depth
max_plan_depth.description: Display-only depth limit for `luuna-missions plan show` recursion through nested sub-plans.

plan_templates.title: Custom plan templates
plan_templates.description: Map of template name → template definition. Overrides the built-in `feature`, `bug`, and `refactor` templates when names collide.

context.prompt: Why does this work need to happen? What problem or opportunity drives it?

approach.prompt: What's the chosen approach, and why this over alternatives?

alternatives.prompt: What other approaches were considered and rejected?

steps.prompt: Decompose into ordered, independent implementation steps. Each becomes a child seed.

risks.prompt: What could go wrong? Known failure modes from prior work are pre-filled when luuna-atlas is available.

acceptance.prompt: Concrete, verifiable conditions for plan completion.

feature.description: New capability or significant change. Default for type: feature.

context.prompt: Why does fixing this matter? Who is affected and how?

reproduction.prompt: Concrete steps to reproduce. Inputs, environment, observed vs. expected.

root_cause.prompt: What's actually broken? Trace the defect to its source, not just the symptom.

approach.prompt: Chosen fix and the rationale for it over alternatives.

steps.prompt: Ordered fix steps. Each becomes a child seed.

acceptance.prompt: Verifiable conditions: regression test, behavior, etc.

bug.description: Defect fix. Adds reproduction and root_cause sections. Default for type: bug.

context.prompt: Why this refactor? What pain does it relieve?

behavior_invariant.prompt: The contract that MUST remain equal across the refactor. Be specific — this is what acceptance tests verify.

steps.prompt: Ordered restructuring steps. Each becomes a child seed.

acceptance.prompt: How we'll verify the invariant is preserved.

refactor.description: Internal restructuring. Adds behavior_invariant (must stay equal). Opt-in via --template refactor.

description.title: Description
description.description: Human-readable summary shown in `luuna-missions plan templates`.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Map of section name → spec. Each section becomes a field in the plan submission.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether this section must be present in the plan submission.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `text` for free text, `list` for an array, `steps` for an ordered step list, or an object describing nested sub-fields.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Question or instruction shown to the LLM when filling this section.

min.title: Minimum items
min.description: Minimum item count when `kind` is `list` or `steps`.

item.title: Item shape
item.description: When `kind` is `list`, the per-item shape: `text` for strings or an object spec for structured items.

atlas_source.title: Atlas source
atlas_source.description: Optional record type (e.g. `failure`, `decision`) seeded into `prior_art` when emitting a plan prompt.
